section_summary.extract_value: This section reports exploratory factor analysis results for the female subsample, noting that although two eigenvalues exceeded 1.00, parallel analysis and the scree plot supported a single-factor solution explaining 48.4% of variance. It also reports scale adequacy (KMO = 0.75; Bartlett's test highly significant) and that the BAS-2 demonstrated acceptable internal consistency in women (Cronbach's ˛ = .87).
section_summary.evidence_source: "The KMO (0.75) and Bartlett's test of sphericity, -2(45) = 2822.41, p < .001, suggested the factorability of the correlation matrix." "The parallel analysis on 1000 sets of parallel data (1 = 1.32 and 2 = 1.26) indicated a single-factor solution should be settled upon, explaining 48.4% of the total variance." "Internal consistency coefficient oftheBAS-2 was acceptable in women (Cronbach's ˛= .87)."
